prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: a finished raster teaching illustration for a university Slidev deck, displayed beside native text. It must make the concept understandable.
Style family: the provided image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its clean contemporary 2D editorial contours, simple matte fills, rounded corners, restrained geometric perspective and natural simplified figures. Use overlap for depth. Draw a NEW composition suited to the specified teaching concept. Do not copy the reference's people, table or objects unless requested.
Composition: a complete airy landscape scene, approximately 3:2. Large readable shapes and clear relationships, generous margins, no cropping. Diagrams use precise geometry and clean connectors, with no unnecessary characters. Avoid tiny details.
Background: genuine alpha transparency outside the actual illustration. Opaque white can appear within papers, interfaces and intentional bounded diagram surfaces. No full-canvas colored backdrop, clouds, vignette, blur, glow, drop shadows, outer border or enclosing card.
Constraints: no grain, textures, shaded 3D, gradients, photorealism, sketches, decorative sparks or ornamental foliage. No lettering, words or numbers except the exact text explicitly requested in the subject. Keep the image calm, explanatory and coordinated with the reference.
Palette: Tailwind lime/green: lime-950 #192E03 fine outlines, lime-800 #3C6300 selected structural details, lime-100 #ECFCCA and green-100 #DCFCE7 light fills, white papers; one tiny lime-300 #BBF451 selection.
Asset exception: a complete landscape 1.75:1 educational customer journey chart on a flat white paper surface with clean margins and NO border. Use the full area for the chart. Every label must be large, sharp and readable at 680 px display width. Use clean sans-serif fonts similar to Inter; no serif, perspective text or 3D miniatures. Illustrative qualitative journey, not real research data.
Subject and EXACT content:
Composition: a narrow left label gutter, then five equal-width aligned columns. At top a modest left-aligned title "Prenotare un volo". Below it, phase headings on a continuous dark green metro-like line with exactly five numbered circular stops (1, 2, 3, 4, 5). Compact paper miniatures under the stops, above the matrix. Light pale teal row surfaces and very fine separators, no repeated card boxes around every cell.
Rows in order: "Azioni", "Punti di contatto", "Pensieri", then a tall "Emozioni" band with one continuous green emotion curve crossing all five columns, then "Opportunità". Each column gets exactly one entry in each row. Thought entries sit in simple clean outlined speech bubbles. In the emotion band, the curve passes through exactly five small circular nodes with the emotion word nearby: moderately positive at Preparare, a little higher at Cercare, falls to low at Scegliere, slightly higher but still low at Pagare, rises clearly high at Confermare. This is a qualitative illustrative trajectory: no numeric vertical scale.
Exact Italian text, left to right:
Phase headings: "Preparare", "Cercare", "Scegliere", "Pagare", "Confermare".
Azioni: "Meta e date", "Confrontare voli", "Tariffa ed extra", "Dati e pagamento", "Salvare il biglietto".
Punti di contatto: "Chat · calendario", "Motore di ricerca", "Sito della compagnia", "Modulo · carta", "Email · app".
Pensieri: "Dove andiamo?", "Quale volo conviene?", "Cosa è incluso?", "È il prezzo finale?", "Tutto pronto!".
Emozioni: "Entusiasmo", "Curiosità", "Confusione", "Tensione", "Sollievo".
Opportunità: "Date condivise", "Confronto semplice", "Costi trasparenti", "Pagamento chiaro", "Ticket a portata di mano".
Constraints: render every listed text accurately, with correct Italian accented letters and punctuation. No extra text. Each label belongs to its correct phase. Keep all text fully visible. The image must explain an experience, not show real research data or imply a journey for the separate fictional physiotherapy persona Viola. Preserve the original's phase-matrix and emotional-curve identity, but improve legibility substantially.
